_meta.note: Video files are NOT in git. They are deployed straight to the media site from a folder — 238 MB for episode 01 alone would bloat the repo permanently, and there are more episodes.
_meta.subtitleNote: Timings from Whisper, words from the church document — see scripts/align_subtitles.py. Each recording only carries subtitles in the language it is spoken in: the Chinese and English scripts are 161 and 157 paragraphs and do not correspond, so pairing them across languages would drift.
_meta.transcriptNote: The full script is NOT carried here. It lives in the .vtt subtitle files with real timings, and its source is the church .docx that scripts/align_subtitles.py reads. Keeping a third untimed copy in the bundle was 28 KB that could only ever drift out of step with the other two.
